title: lipovseklab/qc-pipeline pipeline parameters
description: QC pipeline for mouse utricle single-cell data: cell calling, doublet detection, minimal filtering, dimensionality reduction, clustering, outlier removal and cNMF gene expression programs.

run_options.title: Run options
run_options.description: What to run, on which dataset. Put these in a run.yaml and pass it with -params-file.

step.description: qc, outliers (outlier removal on a qc output), all (qc then outliers), or the cNMF steps on an annotated adata: cnmf, then consensus, then analysis (separate runs on the same outdir).

datasets.description: The dataset to process (exactly one entry for now).

name.description: Short dataset name (no spaces); used in output file names, e.g. alldata.

adata.description: Input AnnData. step qc/all: raw (cell-called or, with skip_cellbender: false, all droplets). step outliers: adata_doublets.h5ad from a qc run. cNMF steps: the annotated adata, with raw counts in .raw (or layers['counts']).

batch.description: obs column with the batch (default: plate).

sample.description: obs column used to colour QC plots (default: sample).

celltype_csv.description: Marker table for simple cell typing (required for qc, outliers and all).

skip_cellbender.description: qc: skip CellBender cell calling because the adata is already cell-called (default: true).

cellbender_csv.description: qc: optional per-batch CellBender settings (columns: batch, total_droplets_included, expected_cells).

skip_scSHC.description: Skip scSHC clustering, which needs ~128 GB (default: false).

clusters.description: outliers: obs column with the clusters MADs are computed in, e.g. topo_clusters_ms_res0.4 (required for outliers/all).

doublet_column.description: outliers: obs column with doublet calls 'doublet'/'singlet' (default: scDblFinder_calls).

qc_stats.description: outliers alone: the qc run's reports/stats folder, so the filtering summary covers all stages. Not needed with step all.

cnmf.description: cNMF steps: settings and one entry per subset (`subsets`). Checked in main.nf; see examples/cnmf.yaml and docs/cnmf.md.

column.description: obs column the subsets are taken from, e.g. ctype.

subsets.description: One entry per cNMF run: `value` (of `column`), plus any setting to override; `selected_k`, `threshold` and `clusters` for the consensus and analysis steps. Leave out for the whole dataset.

outdir.description: Output directory where results are published.

container_dir.description: Folder containing the apptainer images (utricle-qc.sif, r-clustering.sif, vaeda.sif, cellbender.sif; cNMF: cnmf_env.sif, cnmf-analysis.sif, clustree.sif).
container_dir.help_text: The images are not stored in git. Defaults to <pipeline>/containers; set per machine via a profile or --container_dir.

allow_dirty.description: Run even if the pipeline code has uncommitted changes (test runs only).
allow_dirty.help_text: By default the pipeline stops when its code has uncommitted changes, so every result can be tied to a commit. The setting and the edited files are recorded in <outdir>/pipeline_info/provenance.json.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix for the execution report files in pipeline_info/ (default: date and time of the run).

gmt.description: cNMF analysis: GO biological process gene sets (.gmt), from bin/fetch_resources.py.

collectri.description: cNMF analysis: CollecTRI network (.parquet), from bin/fetch_resources.py.
